parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The cluster ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~454250~~) operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the cluster.

>  You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the available region list.[](~~612393~~)

example.unifiedCli: aliyun adb describe-table-detail --db-cluster-id am-bp1xxxxxxxx47 --schema-name adb_demo --table-name test --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun adb DescribeTableDetail --region cn-hangzhou --TableName test --DBClusterId 'am-bp1xxxxxxxx47' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --SchemaName adb_demo
